text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain, Malaysia agree to cooperate in construction industry.
- Government seeks to privatise many areas of government services in an effort to curb expenditure, official says.
- Bahrain International Bank acquires 80 percent of U.S.'s Sarah Michaels.
- Bahrain-based Arab Insurance Group to offer 180 million shares to the public in a bid to raise at least $200 million in new capital.
- Bahrain Stock Exchange agrees to list a foreign investment fund with a capital of $100 million in the bourse.
- Commerce minister discusses with a South African team ways of boosting trade exchanges between the two countries.
- Bahrain Stock Exchange to list shares of Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company. The listing will raise to 40 the number of firms registered in the bourse.
- Bahrain sends emergency aid to Iran to help Saturday's earthquake victims.
